Ideally, SGE results for this application have berforehand been run through FLASH2, to merge paired reads, Cutadapt, to trim reads to the exon only, CRISPResso2, to enumerate and map mutations in each sample to a library of inserted templates, and edgeR, to calculate log2 fold changes (LFC) between variant counts in each sample and variant counts in the original HDR template library. This method is optimized for analyzing genomic next-generation sequencing (NGS) data at the exon level. Please upload CSV files containing variant-level data with the following columns (no missing values):"),
         tags$ul(
           tags$li("cDNA_Position"),
           tags$li("Variant_Score"),
           tags$li("Mutation_Type"),
           tags$li("AminoAcid_Position"),

The 'Variant_AminoAcid' and 'WildType_AminoAcid' columns should use the single-letter identifiers for amino acids. 'Variant_Codon' should contain three characters per row, reflecting the 3-nucleotide sequence that codes for the variant amino acid. The 'Database_Classification' column can have any annotations, as long as they are character strings. All columns with numeric entries ('cDNA_Position', 'Variant_Score', 'AminoAcid_Position') must have real number values."),
         h3("Analysis Logic"),
         tags$ul(
           tags$li("1: Scores (e.g., log fold change in cell proliferation) for each variant are first adjusted using", tags$b("LOESS (Locally Estimated Scatterplot Smoothing)"), "across cDNA positions to correct for positional biases in gene editing. Stretches of DNA copied from homology-directed repair templates are more likely to be incorporated into the genome when located close to the CRISPR cut site. Thus, the LOESS adjustment selects the subset of variant scores equal to or greater than the minimum synonymous variant score, fits a curve to the data to visualize positional editing bias, and subtracts the calculated value from each cDNA position to normalize the data."),
           tags$li("2: The normalized scores are then linearly scaled so that the median values of synonymous and nonsense SNVs in each replicate match the average median values of those SNVs across all replicates. The scores are subsequently averaged across donors for each variant to generate a single ", tags$b("New Variant Score"),"(", (tags$code("New_Variant_Score")), ").", tags$b("If only one file is uploaded, some normalization steps replicate 'Donor 1' as 'Donor 2'.")),
           tags$li("3: To derive cutoff values for categorizing each screen variant, an ", tags$b("Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm"), " is applied to the nonsense and synonymous variants in the dataset. The ", tags$code("normalmixEM"), " function from the ", tags$code("mixtools"), " package in R generates a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model, which is used to assign a posterior probability to each variant. The ", tags$b("Non-functional"), " component is defined as having lower score values than the Functional population, so nonsense mutations are also classified as Non-functional. In default settings, the ", tags$b("Non-functional"), " population retains a posterior probability of P(Non-func) ≥ 0.99, while the ", tags$b("Functional"), " population has a P(Non-func) ≤ 0.01; all variants with 0.01 < P(Non-func) < 0.99 are classified as ", tags$b("Intermediate"), ". This analysis methodology was adapted from Findlay GM, Daza RM, Martin B, et al. [PubMed ID: 30209399]."),
           tags$li(
  withMathJax(
    helpText(HTML("In <b> 'Direct Model Fit'</b>, the mixture model from the nonsense and synonymous variants is used to directly calculate posterior probabilities for each variant score, as well as classification cutoff values.<b> This classification method is more versatile and is recommended for use.</b> <br><br>
      The posterior probability that a score \\( x \\) belongs to the <b>Non-functional</b> population is computed as:
      <br><br>
      $$ 
      P(\\text{Non-functional} \\mid x) = 
      \\frac{\\lambda_1 \\cdot \\text{Normal}(x; \\mu_1, \\sigma_1)}{\\lambda_1 \\cdot \\text{Normal}(x; \\mu_1, \\sigma_1) + \\lambda_2 \\cdot \\text{Normal}(x; \\mu_2, \\sigma_2)}
      $$
      <br>
      Where:
      <ul>
        <li><b>\\(\\lambda_1, \\mu_1, \\sigma_1\\)</b> are the mixture weight, mean, and standard deviation of the <i>Non-functional</i> component</li>
        <li><b>\\(\\lambda_2, \\mu_2, \\sigma_2\\)</b> are the parameters for the <i>Functional</i> component</li>
        <li><b>\\(\\text{Normal}(x; \\mu, \\sigma)\\)</b> is the probability density of a gaussian distribution evaluated at variant score \\( x \\)</li>
      </ul>
    "))
  )
),
           tags$li("In ", tags$b("'Random Sampling'"), ", synthetic data points are added across a score range to extrapolate boundary classifications through iterative Gaussian Mixture Models applied to the nonsense and synonymous variant dataset, plus one new data point. The same posterior probability logic as 'Direct Model Fit' is used to classify the data, but the range of scores classified as 'Intermediate' across these trials constitutes the upper and lower bounds of the classification thresholds instead. This mode may help account for variation in the EM algorithm."),
tags$li(HTML("<b>Errors may be resolved by simply rerunning the analysis</b>, as the EM algorithm is an iterative process that converges on a single Gaussian Mixture Model when differences between probability distributions across iterations become negligible. Outliers in the dataset and the inherent randomness of the EM algorithm may contribute to some observed errors.")),
tags$li(HTML("<b>Excluded variants are not used to derive LOESS normalization, median adjustment, and EM model fitting, but still have scores adjusted. Excluded variants are retained in all plots, tables, and final classifications unless the option is toggled off.</b>"))
         ),
         h3("Analysis Controls"),

A smaller Non-functional probability, such as 0.90, indicates that less data will be classified as Intermediate, but there will also be less confidence in the labeling."), 
           tags$li("Use the ", tags$b("'LOESS Span'"), " slider to adjust smoothing for normalization. By default, a value of 0.15 means that 15% of the total data surrounding a given cDNA position is used to fit the regression line. Increasing this value results in broader, smoother fits, while decreasing it creates more localized fits. Adjust the slider to avoid capturing noise while still visualizing positional biases effectively.", tags$b("If the LOESS line does not seem to fit the data, or if there are no observable biases in scores by position, the 'Skip LOESS normalization' button can be toggled on.")),
           tags$li(tags$b("Choose a cutoff estimation method"), ": 'Direct Model Fit', which extrapolates the probability function and cutoff values directly from the differences between nonsense and synonymous variants, or 'Random Sampling', which iteratively adds data points and creates cutoff values based on how each point is classified by the EM (Expectation-Maximization) algorithm."),
           tags$li("If using 'Random Sampling', specify the number of trials, the number of points per trial, and the score range. Each trial will add the specified number of points to the dataset one at a time and derive a classification based on posterior probabilities. Additional trials will improve the robustness of the classification cutoffs derived from the analysis. The upper and lower bounds of values classified as ", tags$b("Intermediate"), " will be extrapolated as the respective cutoff values and averaged accross trials.", tags$b("If 'Direct Model Fit' is active, the aforementioned parameters do not need to be specified."))
         ),
         h3("Run & Review"),
         tags$ul(
           tags$li("Click ", tags$b("'Run Analysis'"), " to process and classify variants."),
           tags$li("Switch between tabs to explore LOESS normalization, donor comparisons, cutoff summaries, probability distributions, and heatmaps."),
           tags$li("Use the ", tags$b("'Download Full SGE Analyzed Data'"), " button to export the full results table without columns removed, or", tags$b("'Download Cleaned SGE Analyzed Data'"), "to export a simplified table. You may also download the", tags$b("'ChimeraX Attribute File'"),"to map the residue-averaged scores for missense variants onto a protein structure. When the file is opened in ChimeraX, it can be applied directly to the model being visualized by going to ", tags$b("Tools → Structure Analysis → Render/Select by Attribute"), ". Here, the new attribute for residues should appear as ", tags$code("SGE_Score"), ", and the display options can be adjusted according to preference.")
         ),
         h3("Plot Descriptions"),
         tags$ul(
           tags$li(tags$b("DNA Position Plot"), ": LOESS-normalized and donor-averaged variant scores plotted against cDNA position. Points are colored by mutation type, and point shapes depict database classifications. The screen-derived classification thresholds are also visualized with horizontal lines, and hovering over individual points reveals additional classification information."),
           tags$li(tags$b("Score by Mutation Type"), ": Normalized and donor-averaged scores are categorized by variant type, colored by classification, with point shapes reflecting database classifications. The screen-derived cutoff thresholds are visualized with horizontal lines. Error bars for each variant type represent the median and 25th/75th quantiles. P-values from Wilcoxon Test are also shown. Histograms plotting variants by mutation type and variants by database classification also appear in this tab."),
           tags$li(tags$b("Donor vs Donor"), ": Comparison of normalized scores between donors with correlation. This graph can highlight discordant mutation scores between donors. For three donors, correlation is shown for all combinations of donors. "),
           tags$li(tags$b("Standard Deviation Plot"), ": Displays the Standard Deviation of all Variant Scores in relation to the classification thresholds. It may help decern variants to exclude or highlight. "),
           tags$li(tags$b("Donor LOESS Fits"), ": Raw scores with LOESS smoothing for each donor. This graph responds in real time to adjustments of the LOESS span parameter and can be used to visualize the validity of positional bias correction. Inputing the location of Cas9 cutsites will allow for them to be visualized on these plots aswell."),
           tags$li(
  tags$b("Posterior Probability Curve"), 
  ": Gaussian Mixture Model-derived probabilities of non-functionality by variant score. Regardless of the analysis methodology, this graph shows how cutoff thresholds are extrapolated. In the 'Direct Model Fit' methodology, the posterior probability of each point's classification can be viewed on hover.", 
  tags$ul(tags$li("This tab also contains an", tags$b("ROC Plot"), "that shows how the Posterior Probability predicts nonsense and synonymous mutations in terms of True Positives and False Positives. This essentially indicates the discrimination power of the EM model. The ", tags$b("Area Under the Curve (AUC)"), " being 1 or close to 1 means that there is no overlap between the nonsense and synonymous mutations, and that the P(Non-functional) values are higher for the nonsense mutations than for the synonymous mutations—in other words, an ideal classifier. If the AUC is closer to 0.5, the predictive power of P(Non-functional) worsens, as it starts to resemble random chance. An AUC < 0.5 is worse than random chance. If the AUC is high but the 'Posterior Probability Curve' is distorted, this could be due to poor separation between the nonsense and synonymous Gaussian distributions, outliers, or random EM model error. If rerunning the analysis does not yield a monotonic curve or valid classifications, then the EM model may not be applicable to the dataset. In this case, the ", tags$b("'ROC Curve Threshold'"), " may be another classification cutoff value to consider. This is calculated by finding the functional score maximizing the", tags$b("Youden’s J statistic (Sensitivity + Specificity – 1)"), ". This threshold optimizes the ratio of True Positives to False Positives."))),
           tags$li(tags$b("Score Heatmap"), ": A base-level scoring heatmap that visualizes how a single nucleotide change affects the amino acid sequence, the Functional score of the variant, and the classification. Wild-type residues are automatically assigned a score of 0 and are denoted in grey text. The DNA sequence above the heatmap is the 'Wild-Type' DNA sequence derived from the missing codon variants in the uploaded files. This derived DNA sequence may include the PAM changes made to HDRT templates.", tags$b("It is necessary to have all base variants for each cDNA position, or else the WT bases/amino acids, WT DNA sequence, and the scores for each tile will not correctly load. The input CSV files should also not include WT rows for the heatmap to generate. Other plots may still work.")), 
tags$li(tags$b("Summary Statistics"), HTML(": Displays values for classification thresholds, number of iterations of the EM algorithm used in the analysis run, proportions for how variants were classified, and the correlation between donors. When three files are input, a multivariate Coefficient of Determination ( R<sup>2</sup> ) is calculated in addition to pairwise correlations, denoted as '3 Donor  R<sup>2</sup> ' . The Coefficient of Determination is the proportion of variability explained by the three-dimensional 'best-fit' vector relative to the total variance.")),
         )),
    tabPanel("Donor LOESS Fits",

),

 tabPanel("Summary Statistics", tableOutput("cutoffTable"))

# --- Server: Shiny underlying function Logic ---
server <- function(input, output) {

  clean_Mutation_code <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(x))
}
  # Optional helper (didn't use)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# How many donors are present
donorCount <- reactive({
  1L + as.integer(!is.null(input$file2)) + as.integer(!is.null(input$file3))
})
#tries to screen for invalid column values, especially if < 3 donors
ensure_plot_cols <- function(df) {
  num_cols <- c(
    "ScaledFoldChange_d1", "ScaledFoldChange_d2", "ScaledFoldChange_d3",
    "adjusted_d1", "adjusted_d2", "adjusted_d3",
    "loess_donor1", "loess_donor2", "loess_donor3",
    "Variant_Score_d1", "Variant_Score_d2", "Variant_Score_d3"
  )
  for (nm in num_cols) {
    if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_real_
  }

  chr_cols <- c(
    "Mutation_Type_d1", "Mutation_Type_d2", "Mutation_Type_d3",
    "Mutation_code", "Database_Classification_d1", "Database_Classification_d2", "Database_Classification_d3"
  )
  for (nm in chr_cols) {
    if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  }

  df
}
#  Dynamic LOESS tab: show only plots for uploaded donors 
output$loessUI <- renderUI({
  n <- donorCount()
  out <- list(plotlyOutput("donor1Plot"))
  if (n >= 2) out <- c(out, list(plotlyOutput("donor2Plot")))
  if (n >= 3) out <- c(out, list(plotlyOutput("donor3Plot")))
  tagList(out)
})

#  Dynamic Donor-vs-Donor tab content: show only plots for uploaded donors  
output$scatterUI <- renderUI({
  n <- donorCount()
  outs <- list()
  if (n >= 2) outs <- c(outs, list(plotlyOutput("scatter12Plot")))
  if (n >= 3) {
    outs <- c(outs, list(
      plotlyOutput("scatter23Plot"),
      plotlyOutput("scatter13Plot"),
      plotlyOutput("avg12VsDonor3Plot"),
      plotlyOutput("donor3dPlot")
    ))
  }
  if (length(outs) == 0) {
    return(tags$div(style="padding:10px;", "Upload at least two donors to see comparison plots."))
  }
  tagList(outs)
})

# Shared colors for scatter plots
.scatter_fill_colors <- c(
  "Functional" = "#42bd0d",
  "Intermediate" = "gray",
  "Non-functional" = "#e63f29"
)

# Shared ClinVar shape helpers
prepare_clinvar_shapes <- function(df) {
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) {
    df$Database_Classifications <- rep("NA", nrow(df))
  } else {
    df$Database_Classifications <- replace(
      as.character(df$Database_Classifications),
      is.na(df$Database_Classifications),
      "NA"
    )
  }

  df$Database_Classifications <- factor(df$Database_Classifications)
  df
}

clinvar_shape_values <- reactive({
  df <- averaged_data()
  df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes(df)

  shape_levels <- levels(df$Database_Classifications)
  non_na_levels <- setdiff(shape_levels, "NA")

  shape_values <- setNames(
    rep(c(17, 15, 3, 4, 8, 0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16), length.out = length(non_na_levels)),
    non_na_levels
  )

  if ("NA" %in% shape_levels) shape_values["NA"] <- 16

  shape_values
})
  excluded_codes_vec <- reactive({
  if (is.null(input$excluded_codes) || trimws(input$excluded_codes) == "") return(character(0))
  x <- strsplit(input$excluded_codes, ",")[[1]] %>% trimws()
  x[x != ""]
})

filter_excluded_final <- function(df) {
  exclude_vec <- excluded_codes_vec()

  if (isTRUE(input$hide_excluded_final) &&
      length(exclude_vec) > 0 &&
      "Mutation_code" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(!(clean_Mutation_code(Mutation_code) %in% clean_Mutation_code(exclude_vec)))
  }

  df
}

final_plot_data <- reactive({
  filter_excluded_final(averaged_data())
})

final_augmented_data <- reactive({
  filter_excluded_final(augmented_data())
})

 donor3 <- reactive({

 # ---- 2. LOESS Normalization, Join, and Averaging ----
  compute_averaged_data <- function(df1, df2, df3 = NULL, loess_span, exclude_vec = NULL, skip_loess = FALSE) {
    exclude_vec <- trimws(exclude_vec)
    exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]
  extend_loess_edges <- function(pred_vec) {
    good <- which(!is.na(pred_vec))

  # if everything is NA, just return the vector unchanged
  if (length(good) == 0) return(pred_vec)

  # fill leading NA values with first non-NA prediction
  if (good[1] > 1) {
    pred_vec[1:(good[1] - 1)] <- pred_vec[good[1]]
  }

  # fill trailing NA values with last non-NA prediction
  if (good[length(good)] < length(pred_vec)) {
    pred_vec[(good[length(good)] + 1):length(pred_vec)] <- pred_vec[good[length(good)]]
  }

  pred_vec
}
  # reference-only datasets
  df1_ref <- df1
  df2_ref <- df2
  df3_ref <- df3

  if (!is.null(exclude_vec) && length(exclude_vec) > 0) {
    df1_ref <- df1_ref %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
    df2_ref <- df2_ref %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
    if (!is.null(df3_ref)) {
      df3_ref <- df3_ref %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
    }
  }
  cDNA_all <- sort(unique(c(df1$cDNA_Position, df2$cDNA_Position, if (!is.null(df3)) df3$cDNA_Position else NULL)))
  cDNA_range <- min(cDNA_all):max(cDNA_all)

  if (!skip_loess) {
    # LOESS for Donor 1
    syn_min1 <- min(df1_ref$Variant_Score[df1_ref$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
    df1_loess <- df1_ref %>% filter(Variant_Score >= syn_min1)
    loess1 <- loess(Variant_Score ~ cDNA_Position, data = df1_loess, span = loess_span)
    pred1 <- predict(loess1, newdata = data.frame(cDNA_Position = cDNA_range))
    pred1 <- extend_loess_edges(pred1)
    loess_pred_donor1 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range, loess_donor1 = pred1)

    # LOESS for Donor 2
    syn_min2 <- min(df2_ref$Variant_Score[df2_ref$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
    df2_loess <- df2_ref %>% filter(Variant_Score >= syn_min2)
    loess2 <- loess(Variant_Score ~ cDNA_Position, data = df2_loess, span = loess_span)
    pred2 <- predict(loess2, newdata = data.frame(cDNA_Position = cDNA_range))
    pred2 <- extend_loess_edges(pred2)
    loess_pred_donor2 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range,  loess_donor2 = pred2)

    # LOESS for Donor 3 if available
    if (!is.null(df3)) {
      syn_min3 <- min(df3_ref$Variant_Score[df3_ref$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
      df3_loess <- df3_ref %>% filter(Variant_Score >= syn_min3)
      loess3 <- loess(Variant_Score ~ cDNA_Position, data = df3_loess, span = loess_span)
      pred3 <- predict(loess3, newdata = data.frame(cDNA_Position = cDNA_range))
      pred3 <- extend_loess_edges(pred3)
      loess_pred_donor3 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range,loess_donor3 = pred3)
    }

  } else {
    # Skip LOESS
    loess_pred_donor1 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range, loess_donor1 = 0)
    loess_pred_donor2 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range, loess_donor2 = 0)
    syn_min1 <- min(df1$Variant_Score[df1$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
    syn_min2 <- min(df2$Variant_Score[df2$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.null(df3)) {
      loess_pred_donor3 <- data.frame(`cDNA..` = cDNA_range, loess_donor3 = 0)
      syn_min3 <- min(df3$Variant_Score[df3$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

# Merge Donor 1 and Donor 2
shared_variants <- full_join(df1, df2, by = "Mutation_code", suffix = c("_d1", "_d2"))

# Ensure critical columns exist
for (col in c("Variant_Score_d1", "Variant_Score_d2", "Mutation_Type_d1", "Mutation_Type_d2",
              "cDNA_Position_d1", "Database_Classification_d1")) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(shared_variants)) {
    shared_variants[[col]] <- NA
  }
}

# Continue transformations
shared_variants <- shared_variants %>%
  mutate(
    `cDNA..` = as.integer(cDNA_Position_d1),
    Database_Classifications = Database_Classification_d1
  ) %>%
  left_join(loess_pred_donor1, by = "cDNA..") %>%
  left_join(loess_pred_donor2, by = "cDNA..") %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_d1 = Variant_Score_d1 - loess_donor1,
    adjusted_d2 = Variant_Score_d2 - loess_donor2,
    Mutation.type = Mutation_Type_d1
  )

  # Add Donor 3 if provided
  if (!is.null(df3)) {
    shared_variants <- full_join(shared_variants, df3, by = "Mutation_code") %>%
      left_join(loess_pred_donor3, by = "cDNA..") %>%
      mutate(adjusted_d3 = Variant_Score - loess_donor3)
  }

  # Compute scaling factors using NON-excluded variants only
scaling_variants <- shared_variants

if (!is.null(exclude_vec) && length(exclude_vec) > 0) {
  scaling_variants <- scaling_variants %>%
    filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
}

shared_variants_syn <- scaling_variants %>% filter(Mutation.type == "Syn")
shared_variants_non <- scaling_variants %>% filter(Mutation.type == "Non")

syn_medians <- c(
  median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d1, na.rm = TRUE),
  median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

non_medians <- c(
  median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d1, na.rm = TRUE),
  median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

if (!is.null(df3)) {
  syn_medians <- c(
    syn_medians,
    median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d3, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  non_medians <- c(
    non_medians,
    median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d3, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

syn_scale_value <- mean(syn_medians, na.rm = TRUE)
non_scale_value <- mean(non_medians, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor_d1 <- (non_scale_value - syn_scale_value) /
  (median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d1, na.rm = TRUE) -
     median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d1, na.rm = TRUE))

shift_factor_d1 <- syn_scale_value -
  scale_factor_d1 * median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d1, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor_d2 <- (non_scale_value - syn_scale_value) /
  (median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d2, na.rm = TRUE) -
     median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d2, na.rm = TRUE))

shift_factor_d2 <- syn_scale_value -
  scale_factor_d2 * median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d2, na.rm = TRUE)

shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d1 <- shared_variants$adjusted_d1 * scale_factor_d1 + shift_factor_d1
shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d2 <- shared_variants$adjusted_d2 * scale_factor_d2 + shift_factor_d2

if (!is.null(df3)) {
  scale_factor_d3 <- (non_scale_value - syn_scale_value) /
    (median(shared_variants_non$adjusted_d3, na.rm = TRUE) -
       median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d3, na.rm = TRUE))

  shift_factor_d3 <- syn_scale_value -
    scale_factor_d3 * median(shared_variants_syn$adjusted_d3, na.rm = TRUE)

  shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d3 <- shared_variants$adjusted_d3 * scale_factor_d3 + shift_factor_d3

  shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_mean <- rowMeans(
    cbind(
      shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d1,
      shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d2,
      shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d3
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
} else {
  shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_mean <- rowMeans(
    cbind(
      shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d1,
      shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_d2
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

shared_variants$adj_avg_score <- shared_variants$ScaledFoldChange_mean

  # Storing LOESS Predictions and lower bound of data used for LOESS
  attr(shared_variants, "loess1_df") <- loess_pred_donor1
  attr(shared_variants, "loess2_df") <- loess_pred_donor2
  attr(shared_variants, "syn_min1") <- syn_min1
  attr(shared_variants, "syn_min2") <- syn_min2
  if (!is.null(df3)) {
    attr(shared_variants, "loess3_df") <- loess_pred_donor3
    attr(shared_variants, "syn_min3") <- syn_min3
  }

 return(shared_variants)
}

 # ---- 4. EM Gaussian Mixture Model & Probability Assignment ----
  em_result <- reactive({
  exclude_vec <- strsplit(input$excluded_codes, ",")[[1]] %>% trimws()
  exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]

  df_all <- averaged_data()

  df_fit <- df_all %>%
    filter(Mutation.type %in% c("Non", "Syn"))

  if (length(exclude_vec) > 0) {
    df_fit <- df_fit %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
  }

  mixmdl <- tryCatch(
    normalmixEM(df_fit$adj_avg_score, k = 2),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
if (is.null(mixmdl)) {
    df_all <- df_all %>%
      mutate(
        posterior1 = NA_real_,
        class = NA_character_
      )

    return(list(df = df_all, model = NULL))
}
  
  ordering <- order(mixmdl$mu)
  mu1 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[1]]
  mu2 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[2]]
  sigma1 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[1]]
  sigma2 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[2]]
  lambda1 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[1]]
  lambda2 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[2]]

  posterior1_fun <- function(x) {
    num <- lambda1 * dnorm(x, mean = mu1, sd = sigma1)
    denom <- num + lambda2 * dnorm(x, mean = mu2, sd = sigma2)
    num / denom
  }

  df_all <- df_all %>%
    mutate(
      posterior1 = posterior1_fun(adj_avg_score),
      class = ifelse(
        posterior1 >= input$nonfunc_threshold, "Non-functional",
        ifelse(posterior1 <= input$func_threshold, "Functional", "Intermediate")
      )
    )

  list(df = df_all, model = mixmdl)
})

  #  Random Cutoff Estimation for Classification 
  # Extrapolated GMM cutoff calculation function 
# Input: data frame containing adj_avg_score for Nonsense and Synonymous only

estimate_extrapolated_cutoffs <- function(df, n_trials, n_points, 
                                          min_val = input$min_val, 
                                          max_val = input$max_val, 
                                          cutoff_mode = "random", 
                                          return_all = FALSE,
                                          exclude_vec = NULL) {
  exclude_vec <- trimws(exclude_vec)
exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]

fit_df <- df %>%
  filter(Mutation.type %in% c("Non", "Syn"))

if (length(exclude_vec) > 0) {
  fit_df <- fit_df %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
}

data_thresholdnon_syn <- fit_df %>%
  select(adj_avg_score)

  # === Mode: Direct EM fit to original Non/Syn data ===
 if (cutoff_mode == "direct") {
  mixmdl <- tryCatch(
    mixtools::normalmixEM(data_thresholdnon_syn$adj_avg_score, k = 2, maxit = 1000,  verb = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(mixmdl)) {
    return(list(
      cutoffs = data.frame(Est_Cutoff_Low = NA, Est_Cutoff_High = NA),
      random_points = data.frame()
    ))
  }

  # Sort components by mean (so lower mean = nonfunc )
  ordering <- order(mixmdl$mu)
  mu1 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[1]]
  mu2 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[2]]
  sigma1 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[1]]
  sigma2 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[2]]
  lambda1 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[1]]
  lambda2 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[2]]

  # Posterior probability for "Non-functional"
  #probability a given value x belongs to the first Gaussian distribution (component 1) in a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model 
  posterior1_fun <- function(x) {
    num <- lambda1 * dnorm(x, mean = mu1, sd = sigma1)
    denom <- num + lambda2 * dnorm(x, mean = mu2, sd = sigma2)
    return(num / denom)
  }

  # --- Find cutoffs for Intermediate boundaries ---
  score_range <- range(df$adj_avg_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Lower: posterior = input$nonfunc_threshold (lower boundary of Intermediate)
  #uniroot used to solve function directly  for when posterior1_fun(x) = lower threshold (e.g., 0.99)
  lower_cut <- tryCatch(
    uniroot(function(x) posterior1_fun(x) - input$nonfunc_threshold, interval = score_range, extendInt = "yes")$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  # Upper: posterior = input$func_threshold (upper boundary of Intermediate)
  upper_cut <- tryCatch(
    uniroot(function(x) posterior1_fun(x) - input$func_threshold, interval = score_range, extendInt = "yes")$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  # Apply posterior calculation to all data for output
  df_full <- df %>%
    mutate(
      posterior_nonfunc = posterior1_fun(adj_avg_score),
      label = case_when(
        posterior_nonfunc >= input$nonfunc_threshold ~ "Non-functional",
        posterior_nonfunc <= input$func_threshold ~ "Functional",
        TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
      )
    )

  out <- data.frame(
    Est_Cutoff_Low = lower_cut,
    Est_Cutoff_High = upper_cut
  )

  return(list(
  cutoffs = out,
  random_points = df_full,
  model = mixmdl  
))
}




  # === Mode: Random sampling extrapolation ===
  range_results_list <- vector("list", n_trials)
  all_point_data <- data.frame()
#iterative data sampling and cutoff extraction
  for (i in seq_len(n_trials)) {
    new_point_labels <- data.frame(
      adj_avg_score = numeric(),
      posterior.comp.1 = numeric(),
      posterior.comp.2 = numeric(),
      label = character(),
      iteration = integer(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    for (iteration in seq_len(n_points)) {
      new_point <- data.frame(adj_avg_score = runif(1, min = min_val, max = max_val))
      dat <- rbind(data_thresholdnon_syn, new_point)

      mixmdl <- tryCatch(
        mixtools::normalmixEM(dat$adj_avg_score, k = 2, maxit = 1000, verb = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(mixmdl)) next

      ordering <- order(mixmdl$mu)
      mu_diff <- abs(diff(mixmdl$mu[ordering]))
      
      #if difference between the means of the nonsense and synonoumous distributions is >0.1, another itteration will run
      if (mu_diff < 0.1) next

      mixmdl$mu <- mixmdl$mu[ordering]
      mixmdl$sigma <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering]
      mixmdl$lambda <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering]
      mixmdl$posterior <- mixmdl$posterior[, ordering]

      posterior <- mixmdl$posterior
      new_point_posterior <- posterior[nrow(posterior), ]

      new_point_label <- ifelse(
        new_point_posterior[1] >= input$nonfunc_threshold, "Non-functional",
        ifelse(new_point_posterior[1] <= input$func_threshold, "Functional", "Intermediate")
      )

      new_point_labels <- rbind(new_point_labels, data.frame(
        adj_avg_score = new_point$adj_avg_score,
        posterior.comp.1 = new_point_posterior[1],
        posterior.comp.2 = new_point_posterior[2],
        label = new_point_label,
        iteration = iteration
      ))
    }

    intermediate_results <- new_point_labels %>% filter(label == "Intermediate")
    value_range <- if (nrow(intermediate_results) > 0) range(intermediate_results$adj_avg_score, na.rm = TRUE) else c(NA, NA)

    range_results_list[[i]] <- data.frame(Run = i, Min = value_range[1], Max = value_range[2])
    new_point_labels$Run <- i
    all_point_data <- rbind(all_point_data, new_point_labels)
  }

  combined_ranges <- do.call(rbind, range_results_list) %>% na.omit()

  if (nrow(combined_ranges) == 0) {
    out <- data.frame(
      Est_Cutoff_Low = NA_real_,
      Est_Cutoff_High = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    out <- data.frame(
      Est_Cutoff_Low = round(mean(combined_ranges$Min, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
      Est_Cutoff_High = round(mean(combined_ranges$Max, na.rm = TRUE), 5)
    )
  }

  return(list(
    cutoffs = out,
    random_points = if (return_all) all_point_data else NULL
  ))
}



  
cutoff_estimation <- reactive({
  df <- averaged_data()

  exclude_vec <- strsplit(input$excluded_codes, ",")[[1]] %>% trimws()
  exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]

  estimate_extrapolated_cutoffs(
    df,
    n_trials = input$num_trials,
    n_points = input$num_random,
    min_val = input$min_val,
    max_val = input$max_val,
    cutoff_mode = input$cutoff_mode,
    return_all = TRUE,
    exclude_vec = exclude_vec
  )
})
 

 # ---- 5. Plot: Heatmap ----
output$scoreHeatmap <- renderPlotly({
  cutoffs <- cutoff_estimation()$cutoffs  
  df <- raw_averaged_data()

  
# Determine codon position based on cDNA position offset
min_pos <- min(df$cDNA_Position_d2, na.rm = TRUE)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    codon_pos = (cDNA_Position_d2 - min_pos) %% 3 + 1,
    Base = case_when(
      codon_pos == 1 ~ substr(Variant_Codon_d2, 1, 1),
      codon_pos == 2 ~ substr(Variant_Codon_d2, 2, 2),
      codon_pos == 3 ~ substr(Variant_Codon_d2, 3, 3),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
# Add WT rows to ensure all 4 bases exist per DNA position
all_bases <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
empty_row <- df[0, ]

wt_rows <- df %>%
  group_by(cDNA_Position_d2) %>%
  do({
    pos_df <- .
    bases_present <- pos_df$Base
    missing_bases <- setdiff(all_bases, bases_present)
    codon_pos <- ((pos_df$cDNA_Position_d2[1] - min_pos) %% 3) + 1
    if (length(missing_bases) > 0) {
      wt_rows_list <- lapply(missing_bases, function(base) {
        example_row <- pos_df[1, ]
        wt_codon <- example_row$Variant_Codon_d2
        substr(wt_codon, codon_pos, codon_pos) <- base
        example_row$Variant_Codon_d2 <- wt_codon
        example_row$Variant_AminoAcid_d2 <- example_row$WildType_AminoAcid_d2
        example_row$Mutation.type <- "WT"
        example_row$adj_avg_score <- 0
        example_row$Base <- base
        example_row
      })
      bind_rows(wt_rows_list)
    } else {
      empty_row
    }
  }) %>% ungroup()

# Add WT rows to full df
df <- bind_rows(df, wt_rows)
exclude_vec <- strsplit(input$excluded_codes, ",")[[1]] %>% trimws()
exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]
exclude_vec <- clean_Mutation_code(exclude_vec)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Mutation_code_clean = clean_Mutation_code(Mutation_code),
    is_excluded_variant = isTRUE(input$hide_excluded_final) &
      Mutation_code_clean %in% exclude_vec,

    adj_avg_score = ifelse(is_excluded_variant, 0, adj_avg_score),

    Database_Classification_d2 = ifelse(
      Mutation.type == "WT",
      NA_character_,
      Database_Classification_d2
    ),

    auto_classification = case_when(
      is_excluded_variant ~ "Excluded",
      adj_avg_score == 0 & Mutation.type == "WT" ~ NA_character_,
      adj_avg_score <= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low ~ "Non-functional",
      adj_avg_score >= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High ~ "Functional",
      TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
    )
  )
  wild_types <- df %>% filter(Mutation.type == "WT")
wild_types$Base <- wild_types$Base
  # WT entries
wild_types_compact <- wild_types %>%
  transmute(
    Score = adj_avg_score,
    Base = Base,
    AminoAcid = WildType_AminoAcid_d2,
    DNA_Position = cDNA_Position_d2,
    AA_Position = AminoAcid_Position_d2,
    Mutation_Type = Mutation.type,
    Database = Database_Classification_d2,
    Classification = auto_classification,
    Codon = Variant_Codon_d2, 
    Text = "",
    Color = "grey",
    Border = NA,
    face = "bold"
  )

# Non-WT entries
non_wild_types <- df %>%
    filter(Mutation.type != "WT", !is.na(adj_avg_score))
  non_wild_types$Base <- non_wild_types$Base
non_wild_types_compact <- non_wild_types %>%
  transmute(
    Score = adj_avg_score,
    Base = Base,
    AminoAcid = Variant_AminoAcid_d2,
    DNA_Position = cDNA_Position_d2,
    AA_Position = AminoAcid_Position_d2,
    Mutation_Type = Mutation.type,
    Database = Database_Classification_d2,
    Classification = auto_classification,
    Codon = Variant_Codon_d2,  
    Text = "",
    Color = "black",
    Border = NA,
    face = "plain"
  )

  # Combine
  heatmap_df <- bind_rows(non_wild_types_compact, wild_types_compact)
  heatmap_df_part1 <- heatmap_df
  heatmap_df_part1$Base <- as.factor(heatmap_df_part1$Base)

  aa_positions_df <- heatmap_df_part1[order(heatmap_df_part1$DNA_Position), c("Score", "DNA_Position", "AA_Position")]
  aa_positions_subset <- aa_positions_df[seq(1, nrow(aa_positions_df), by = 60), ]

  # Wildtype annotation
  wild_type_labels <- wild_types_compact[, c("Base", "DNA_Position", "Score")]
  wild_type_labels <- unique(wild_type_labels)
  wild_type_labels$y_position <- max(as.numeric(factor(wild_type_labels$Base))) + 1
  wild_type_labels_part1 <- wild_type_labels
# Calculate percentiles of Score for color grading
score_lower <- quantile(heatmap_df_part1$Score, 0.15, na.rm = TRUE)
score_middle <- quantile(heatmap_df_part1$Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE)
score_upper <- quantile(heatmap_df_part1$Score, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate average score for synonymous mutations
syn_avg <- mean(heatmap_df_part1$Score[heatmap_df_part1$Mutation_Type == "Syn"], na.rm = TRUE)
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(heatmap_df_part1, aes(x = DNA_Position, y = Base, fill = Score)) +
    geom_tile(aes(
      text = paste("DNA Pos:", DNA_Position,
               "<br>AA Pos:", AA_Position,
               "<br>Amino Acid:", AminoAcid,
               "<br>Base:", Base,
               "<br>Codon:", Codon,  
               "<br>New Variant Score:", round(Score, 3),
               "<br>Mutation Type:", Mutation_Type,
               "<br>Database:", Database,
               "<br>Screen Classification:", Classification)),
  linewidth = 0.5
) +
    geom_text(label = heatmap_df_part1$AminoAcid, colour = heatmap_df_part1$Color, size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("red", "white", "lightblue"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(score_lower, 0, score_upper)),  # map percentiles to color
    limits = c(score_lower, score_upper),
    oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Score"
    ) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    labs(x = "Position (Scroll Left)", y = "Base Change") +
    geom_text(
      data = aa_positions_subset,
      aes(x = DNA_Position, y = max(as.numeric(heatmap_df_part1$Base)) + 0.6, label = AA_Position),
      vjust = 0.6, size = 4, color = "black") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.4))) +
    geom_text(
      data = wild_type_labels_part1,
      aes(x = DNA_Position, label = Base, y = y_position),
      vjust = 0, size = 4,  color = "black"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 1, barheight = 5)) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 20)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(
      hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
      xaxis = list(
        automargin = TRUE,
        fixedrange = FALSE,
        range = c(min(heatmap_df_part1$DNA_Position), min(heatmap_df_part1$DNA_Position) + 40)
      )
    )
})

        "Donor3 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3), "<br>",
        "New Variant Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_mean, 3), "<br>",
                  "Mutation Type: ", Mutation.type, "<br>",
                  "Database: ", Database_Classifications, "<br>",
                  "Screen Classification: ", auto_class))
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    # Lower cutoff interactive segment
  geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = min(df$cDNA..)-10, xend = max(df$cDNA..)+10, y = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low),
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y,
                   text = paste0("Lower cutoff = ", round(y, 3))),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,

  # Upper cutoff interactive segment
  geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = min(df$cDNA..)-10, xend = max(df$cDNA..)+10, y = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High),
               aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y,
                   text = paste0("Upper cutoff = ", round(y, 3))),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,

      title = "Adjusted Scores (Averaged)",

})

 # ---- 7. Plot: Score by Mutation Type ----
  
 scoreTypePlot_gg <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  cutoffs <- cutoff_estimation()$cutoffs  # Extract cutoff dataframe
is_valid_clinvar_value <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  !is.na(x) &
    x != "" &
    !(tolower(x) %in% c("unclassified", "na", "n/a", "none", "null"))
}
  # Assign classification
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(auto_class = case_when(
      adj_avg_score <= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low ~ "Non-functional",
      adj_avg_score >= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High ~ "Functional",
      TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
    ))
  
# ensure ClinVar column exists 
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) df$Database_Classifications <- NA
  
  #P values and error bars
  comparisons <- list(
  c("Mis", "Non"),
  c("Mis", "Syn"),
  c("Non", "Syn")
)
  format_p_label <- function(p) {
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
}
  pval_df <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(comparisons), function(i) {
  g1 <- comparisons[[i]][1]
  g2 <- comparisons[[i]][2]

  test_df <- df %>%
    filter(Mutation.type %in% c(g1, g2))

  p_val <- wilcox.test(
    adj_avg_score ~ Mutation.type, data = test_df)$p.value

  data.frame(
    group1 = g1,group2 = g2, x = match(g1, c("Mis", "Non", "Syn")),
    xend = match(g2, c("Mis", "Non", "Syn")),y = max(df$adj_avg_score, 
    na.rm = TRUE) + i * 1.2, label = format_p_label(p_val))
})
  summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Mutation.type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_score = median(adj_avg_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(adj_avg_score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(adj_avg_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes(df)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(
    x = Mutation.type,
    y = adj_avg_score,
    color = auto_class,
    shape = Database_Classifications,   
    text = paste0("cDNA Pos: ", cDNA.., "<br>",
                  "Mutation Code: ", Mutation_code, "<br>",
            "Donor1 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d1, 3), "<br>",
        "Donor2 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d2, 3), "<br>",
        "Donor3 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3), "<br>",
        "New Variant Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_mean, 3), "<br>",
                  "Database: ", Database_Classifications, "<br>",
                  "Screen Classification: ", auto_class))) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +  
    geom_segment(data = pval_df,
             aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
geom_segment(data = pval_df,
             aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y, yend = y - 0.25),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
geom_segment(data = pval_df,
             aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y - 0.25),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
geom_text(data = pval_df,
          aes(x = (x + xend)/2, y = y + 0.45, label = label),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4, fontface = "italic") +
    geom_errorbar(data = summary_df, aes( x = Mutation.type,ymin = q25,ymax = q75),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE,width = 0.25,color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = summary_df,
             aes(x = as.numeric(factor(Mutation.type)) - 0.08,
                 xend = as.numeric(factor(Mutation.type)) + 0.08,
                 y = median_score, yend = median_score),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low, linetype = "dashed", color = "brown", size = 1.0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 1.0) +
    labs(
      title = "Scores by Mutation Type",
      x = "Mutation Type", y = "Screen Score",
      color = " Screen Classification", 
      shape = "Database Classification" 
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Functional" = "#42bd0d",
      "Intermediate" = "gray",
      "Non-functional" = "#e63f29"
    )) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = clinvar_shape_values(), drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

   p
})

# Colors ClinVar groups automatically by their average score.
# Lower-scoring groups receive warmer colors; higher-scoring groups receive cooler colors.
clinvarHistData <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) return(NULL)

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Database_Classifications = trimws(as.character(Database_Classifications))) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Database_Classifications),
      Database_Classifications != "",
      Database_Classifications != "NA",
      Database_Classifications != "Unclassified"
    )

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df
})

  req(!is.null(df_clinvar), nrow(df_clinvar) > 0)

  # Named vector required by scale_fill_manual()

    clinvar_color_df$color,
    clinvar_color_df$Database_Classifications
  )

 # ---- 8a. Plot: Posterior S-Curve with Data Points ----
  posteriorPlot_gg <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  cutoff_obj <- cutoff_estimation()
  cutoffs <- cutoff_obj$cutoffs
  mode <- input$cutoff_mode  

  if (mode == "direct" && !is.null(cutoff_obj$model)) {
    mixmdl <- cutoff_obj$model

    # Posterior function from model
    ordering <- order(mixmdl$mu)
    mu1 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[1]]
    mu2 <- mixmdl$mu[ordering[2]]
    sigma1 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[1]]
    sigma2 <- mixmdl$sigma[ordering[2]]
    lambda1 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[1]]
    lambda2 <- mixmdl$lambda[ordering[2]]

    posterior1_fun <- function(x) {
      num <- lambda1 * dnorm(x, mean = mu1, sd = sigma1)
      denom <- num + lambda2 * dnorm(x, mean = mu2, sd = sigma2)
      return(num / denom)
    }

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        posterior1 = posterior1_fun(adj_avg_score),
        auto_class = case_when(
          adj_avg_score <= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low ~ "Non-functional",
          adj_avg_score >= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High ~ "Functional",
          TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
        )
      )

    x_range <- seq(min(df$adj_avg_score, na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(df$adj_avg_score, na.rm = TRUE),
                   length.out = 300)
    smooth_df <- data.frame(
      adj_avg_score = x_range,
      posterior1 = posterior1_fun(x_range)
    )

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = adj_avg_score, y = posterior1)) +
      geom_point(aes(
        text = paste0(
          "Donor1 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d1, 3), "<br>",
        "Donor2 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d2, 3), "<br>",
        "Donor3 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3), "<br>",
        "New Variant Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_mean, 3), "<br>",
          "P(Non-functional): ", round(posterior1, 3), "<br>",
          "Database: ", Database_Classifications, "<br>",
          "Screen Classification: ", auto_class, "<br>",
          "Mutation Type: ", Mutation.type, "<br>",
          "Mutation code: ", Mutation_code
        ),
        color = auto_class
      ), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_line(data = smooth_df, aes(x = adj_avg_score, y = posterior1),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = .5) +geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low),
             aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0, yend = 1.10,
                 text = paste0("Lower cutoff = ", round(x, 3))),
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "brown", size = 0.5) +
geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High),
             aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0, yend = 1.10,
                 text = paste0("Upper cutoff = ", round(x, 3))),
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 0.5) +
      labs(
        title = "          Posterior Probability of Classification vs Score ",
        x = "Screen Score",
        y = "P(Non-functional)",
        color = "Screen Classification"
      ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Functional" = "#42bd0d",
        "Intermediate" = "gray",
        "Non-functional" = "#e63f29"
      )) +
      theme_minimal()+
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

       p

  } else {
    # Fall back to existing logic for 'random'
    em_df <- em_result()$df
    sampled_points <- cutoff_obj$random_points

    combined <- bind_rows(
      em_df %>% select(x = adj_avg_score , y = posterior1),
      sampled_points %>% select(x = adj_avg_score, y = posterior.comp.1)
    ) %>% arrange(x)

    combined <- combined %>%
      mutate(dy = c(diff(y), NA))

    stop_index <- which(combined$dy >= 0)[1]
    if (is.na(stop_index) || stop_index < 5) stop_index <- 10

  
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = em_df, aes(x = adj_avg_score , y = posterior1),
                 size = 1.2, color = "gray40", alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_point(data = sampled_points, aes(x = adj_avg_score, y = posterior.comp.1, color = label),
                 size = 1.8, shape = 17, alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low, linetype = "dashed", color = "brown") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
      labs(
        title = "Probability Distribution (Observed + Randomly Sampled Data)",
        x = "Score",
        y = "P(Non-functional)",
        color = "Sampled Label"
      ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Non-functional" = "#e63f29",
        "Functional" = "#42bd0d",
        "Intermediate" = "gray"
      )) +
      theme_minimal()+
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

     p
  }
})

 # ---- 8b. Plot: ROC curve to test classification of EM model ----
rocPlot_gg <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  cutoff_obj <- cutoff_estimation()
  cutoffs <- cutoff_obj$cutoffs

  # Check required variables are available
  req(!is.null(df), all(c("adj_avg_score", "Mutation.type") %in% colnames(df)))

  # Keep only synonymous and nonsense variants for ROC calculation
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Mutation.type %in% c("Syn", "Non"))

  req(nrow(df) > 0)

  # Create true labels: Syn = 1, Non = 0
  df$true_label <- ifelse(df$Mutation.type == "Syn", 1, 0)

  # Compute ROC curve
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = df$true_label,      # Positive class is 1 = "Syn"
    predictor = df$adj_avg_score,  # Higher values should predict Syn/function
    levels = c(1, 0),              # 1 = Syn, 0 = Non
    direction = ">"                # Larger adj_avg_score values = more likely Syn
  )

  auc_val <- pROC::auc(roc_obj)

  roc_df <- data.frame(
    specificity = roc_obj$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities
  )

  # Score threshold that maximizes Youden's J statistic
  youden_coords <- pROC::coords(
    roc_obj,
    "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity")
  )

  youden_threshold <- as.numeric(youden_coords["threshold"])


youden_j <- as.numeric(youden_coords["sensitivity"]) +
  as.numeric(youden_coords["specificity"]) - 1


  # Plot
  ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              color = "gray85", size = 1.2) +
  geom_step(color = "black", size = 2.8) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.62, y = 0.25,
           label = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3)),
           size = 5) +
  labs(
  title = paste0(
    "ROC Plot: Screen Score Predicting Syn/Non Variants\n",
    "(Score Maximizing Youden’s J Statistic ≈ ",
    round(youden_threshold, 3),
    ")"
  ),
  x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
  y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)"
)+
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
    labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00")
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray40", fill = NA, size = 1.2),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 1.2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
})
output$rocPlot <- renderPlot({
  print(rocPlot_gg())
})

 # ---- 9a.  Plot: Donor1 vs Donor2 ----
scatter12Plot_gg <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  # ensure ClinVar column exists 
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) df$Database_Classifications <- NA
  df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes(df)
  # Require scaled columns
  req("ScaledFoldChange_d1" %in% names(df), "ScaledFoldChange_d2" %in% names(df))
  
  # Functionality from cutoffs
  cutoff_output <- tryCatch(cutoff_estimation(), error = function(e) NULL)
  cutoff_low  <- if(!is.null(cutoff_output) && !is.null(cutoff_output$cutoffs)) cutoff_output$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low else NA_real_
  cutoff_high <- if(!is.null(cutoff_output) && !is.null(cutoff_output$cutoffs)) cutoff_output$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High else NA_real_
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Functionality = case_when(
      !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_low)  & adj_avg_score <= cutoff_low  ~ "Non-functional",
      !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_high) & adj_avg_score >= cutoff_high ~ "Functional",
      TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
    ))
  
  # lm + cor on complete cases
  ok <- complete.cases(df$ScaledFoldChange_d1, df$ScaledFoldChange_d2)
  cor_val <- if (any(ok)) cor(df$ScaledFoldChange_d1[ok], df$ScaledFoldChange_d2[ok]) else NA_real_
  model <- tryCatch(lm(ScaledFoldChange_d2 ~ ScaledFoldChange_d1, data = df[ok, ]), error = function(e) NULL)
  intercept <- if(!is.null(model)) coef(model)[1] else 0
  slope     <- if(!is.null(model)) coef(model)[2] else 1
  
  x_range <- range(df$ScaledFoldChange_d1, na.rm = TRUE)
x_pad <- 0.05 * diff(x_range)

x_range_extended <- c(
  x_range[1] - x_pad,
  x_range[2] + x_pad
)

abline_segment <- data.frame(
  x = x_range_extended[1],
  xend = x_range_extended[2],
  y = intercept + slope * x_range_extended[1],
  yend = intercept + slope * x_range_extended[2],
  hover = paste0(
    "Regression Line<br>",
    "Slope: ", round(slope, 3), "<br>",
    "Intercept: ", round(intercept, 3), "<br>",
    "r = ", ifelse(is.na(cor_val), "NA", formatC(cor_val, digits = 3, format = "f"))
  )
)
  
  has_3_donors <- donorCount() == 3

p <- ggplot(df, aes(
    x = ScaledFoldChange_d1,
    y = ScaledFoldChange_d2,
    color = if (has_3_donors) Functionality else Mutation.type,
    shape = Database_Classifications,
    text = paste0("cDNA Pos: ", cDNA.., "<br>",
      "Mutation Code: ", Mutation_code, "<br>",
      "Donor1 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d1, 3), "<br>",
      "Donor2 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d2, 3), "<br>",
      "Donor3 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3), "<br>",
      "New Variant Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_mean, 3), "<br>",
      "Mutation Type: ", Mutation.type, "<br>",
      "Database: ", Database_Classifications, "<br>",
      "Screen Classification: ", Functionality
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_segment(
    data = abline_segment,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, text = hover),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linetype = "solid",
    size = 0.30
  ) +
  { if (!has_3_donors) geom_abline(intercept = 2 * cutoff_low, slope = -1,
                                   linetype = "dashed", color = "brown", size = 0.9) } +
  { if (!has_3_donors) geom_abline(intercept = 2 * cutoff_high, slope = -1,
                                   linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 0.9) } +
  { 
    if (has_3_donors) {
      scale_color_manual(values = .scatter_fill_colors, name = "Screen Classification")
    } else {
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d"),
        name = "Mutation Type"
      )
    }
  } +
  scale_shape_manual(values = clinvar_shape_values(), drop = FALSE, name = "Database Classification") +
  labs(
    title = "Donor 1 vs Donor 2",
    x = "Donor 1 Score",
    y = "Donor 2 Score",
    caption = paste0("r = ", ifelse(is.na(cor_val), "NA", formatC(cor_val, digits = 3, format = "f")))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "italic", margin = margin(t = 3))
  )
  
  p
})

  cutoff_high <- if(!is.null(cutoff_output) && !is.null(cutoff_output$cutoffs)) cutoff_output$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High else NA_real_
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Functionality = case_when(

# ---- 9d.  Plot: Donor1/Donor2(Avg) vs Donor 3---
avg12VsDonor3Plot_gg <- reactive({
  df <- final_plot_data()
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) df$Database_Classifications <- NA
  df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes(df)

  req("ScaledFoldChange_d1" %in% names(df),
      "ScaledFoldChange_d2" %in% names(df),
      "ScaledFoldChange_d3" %in% names(df))

  cutoff_output <- tryCatch(cutoff_estimation(), error = function(e) NULL)
  cutoff_low  <- if (!is.null(cutoff_output) && !is.null(cutoff_output$cutoffs)) cutoff_output$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low else NA_real_
  cutoff_high <- if (!is.null(cutoff_output) && !is.null(cutoff_output$cutoffs)) cutoff_output$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High else NA_real_

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(avg_d1_d2 = rowMeans(across(c(ScaledFoldChange_d1, ScaledFoldChange_d2)), na.rm = TRUE),
           Functionality = case_when(
             !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_low)  & adj_avg_score <= cutoff_low  ~ "Non-functional",
             !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_high) & adj_avg_score >= cutoff_high ~ "Functional",
             TRUE ~ "Intermediate"))

  ok <- complete.cases(df$avg_d1_d2, df$ScaledFoldChange_d3)
  cor_val <- if (any(ok)) cor(df$avg_d1_d2[ok], df$ScaledFoldChange_d3[ok]) else NA_real_
  model <- tryCatch(lm(ScaledFoldChange_d3 ~ avg_d1_d2, data = df[ok, ]), error = function(e) NULL)
  intercept <- if (!is.null(model)) coef(model)[1] else 0
  slope <- if (!is.null(model)) coef(model)[2] else 1

  x_range <- range(df$avg_d1_d2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_pad <- 0.05 * diff(x_range)
  x_ext <- c(x_range[1] - x_pad, x_range[2] + x_pad)

  abline_segment <- data.frame(
    x = x_ext[1], xend = x_ext[2],
    y = intercept + slope * x_ext[1],
    yend = intercept + slope * x_ext[2],
    hover = paste0("Regression Line<br>",
                   "Slope: ", round(slope, 3), "<br>",
                   "Intercept: ", round(intercept, 3), "<br>",
                   "r = ", ifelse(is.na(cor_val), "NA", formatC(cor_val, digits = 3, format = "f")))
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_d1_d2, y = ScaledFoldChange_d3,
                 color = Mutation.type, shape = Database_Classifications,
                 text = paste0("cDNA Pos: ", cDNA.., "<br>",
                               "Mutation Code: ", Mutation_code, "<br>",
                               "Average Donor 1/2 Score: ", round(avg_d1_d2, 3), "<br>",
                               "Donor3 Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3), "<br>",
                               "New Variant Score: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_mean, 3), "<br>",
                               "Mutation Type: ", Mutation.type, "<br>",
                               "Database: ", Database_Classifications, "<br>",
                               "Screen Classification: ", Functionality))) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_segment(data = abline_segment,
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, text = hover),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "solid", size = 0.30) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 3 * cutoff_low, slope = -2,linetype = "dashed", color = "brown", size = 0.9) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 3 * cutoff_high, slope = -2,linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d"), name = "Mutation Type") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = clinvar_shape_values(), drop = FALSE, name = "Database Classification") +
    labs(title = "Donor 1 and 2 Average vs Donor 3",
         x = "Donors 1 and 2 Average Score", y = "Donor 3 Score",
         caption = paste0("r = ", ifelse(is.na(cor_val), "NA", formatC(cor_val, digits = 3, format = "f")))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "italic", margin = margin(t = 3)))
})

# ---- 9e.  Plot: Donor1 vs Donor2 vs Donor3 ----
output$donor3dPlot <- renderPlotly({
  req(donorCount() == 3)

  df <- final_plot_data()
  
# ensure ClinVar column exists 
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) df$Database_Classifications <- NA
  
  # Get cutoffs for classification coloring (fallback to "Intermediate" if missing)
  co <- tryCatch(cutoff_estimation(), error = function(e) NULL)
  cutoff_low  <- if (!is.null(co) && !is.null(co$cutoffs)) co$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low  else NA_real_
  cutoff_high <- if (!is.null(co) && !is.null(co$cutoffs)) co$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High else NA_real_

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Classification = case_when(
        !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_low)  & adj_avg_score <= cutoff_low  ~ "Non-functional",
        !is.na(adj_avg_score) & !is.na(cutoff_high) & adj_avg_score >= cutoff_high ~ "Functional",
        TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
      ),
      cDNA_pos = coalesce(`cDNA..`, cDNA_Position_d1, cDNA_Position_d2, cDNA_Position),
      Mutation.type = as.character(Mutation.type),
      Database_Classifications = as.character(Database_Classifications),
      Classification = as.character(Classification)
    )

  plot_df <- df %>%
    select(
      Mutation_code, cDNA_pos,
      ScaledFoldChange_d1, ScaledFoldChange_d2, ScaledFoldChange_d3,
      ScaledFoldChange_mean, Mutation.type, Database_Classifications, Classification
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(ScaledFoldChange_d1, ScaledFoldChange_d2, ScaledFoldChange_d3))

  req(nrow(plot_df) > 0)

  # Build hover text
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(hover_txt = paste0("<b>cDNA pos:</b> ", cDNA_pos,
      "<br><b>Mutation Code:</b> ", Mutation_code,
      "<br><b>Donor 1:</b> ", sprintf("%.3f", ScaledFoldChange_d1),
      "<br><b>Donor 2:</b> ", sprintf("%.3f", ScaledFoldChange_d2),
      "<br><b>Donor 3:</b> ", sprintf("%.3f", ScaledFoldChange_d3),
      "<br><b>New Variant Score:</b> ", sprintf("%.3f", ScaledFoldChange_mean),
      "<br><b>Mutation Type:</b> ", Mutation.type,
      "<br><b>Database:</b> ", Database_Classifications,
      "<br><b>Screen Classification:</b> ", Classification
    ))

  # --- Best-fit vector
  M <- as.matrix(plot_df[, c("ScaledFoldChange_d1","ScaledFoldChange_d2","ScaledFoldChange_d3")])
  pc <- prcomp(M, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  mu <- colMeans(M)
  v  <- pc$rotation[, 1]
  t  <- as.vector((M - matrix(mu, nrow(M), 3, byrow = TRUE)) %*% v)
  t0 <- min(t); t1 <- max(t)
  p0 <- mu + v * t0
  p1 <- mu + v * t1

  # R² from proportion of variance explained by bestfit vector
  R2 <- summary(pc)$importance[2, 1]

  p <- plot_ly(
    plot_df,
    x = ~ScaledFoldChange_d1,
    y = ~ScaledFoldChange_d2,
    z = ~ScaledFoldChange_d3,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~Classification,
    colors = .scatter_fill_colors,
    marker = list(size = 3, opacity = 0.85),
    text = ~hover_txt,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
  )

  # Add the best-fit vector
  p <- p %>%
    add_trace(
      x = c(p0[1], p1[1]),
      y = c(p0[2], p1[2]),
      z = c(p0[3], p1[3]),
      type = "scatter3d",
      mode = "lines",
      line = list(width = 6, color = "black"),
      inherit = FALSE,
      showlegend = FALSE,
      hoverinfo = "skip"
    )

  # Add R² text annotation in the corner
  p <- p %>%
    layout(
      annotations = list(
        list(
          text = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", R2)),
          showarrow = FALSE,
          xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
          x = 0, y = 1.05,
          font = list(size = 12)
        )
      ),
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = "Donor 1 Score"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Donor 2 Score"),
        zaxis = list(title = "Donor 3 Score"),
        camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.6, y = 1.6, z = 1.2))
      ),
      legend = list(orientation = "h")
    )

  p
})

prepare_clinvar_shapes_fill <- function(df) {
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) {
    df$Database_Classifications <- rep("NA", nrow(df))
  } else {
    df$Database_Classifications <- replace(
      as.character(df$Database_Classifications),
      is.na(df$Database_Classifications),
      "NA"
    )
  }

  df$Database_Classifications <- factor(df$Database_Classifications)
  df
}

clinvar_fill_shape_values <- reactive({
  df <- averaged_data()
  df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes_fill(df)

  shape_levels <- levels(df$Database_Classifications)
  non_na_levels <- setdiff(shape_levels, "NA")

  shape_values <- setNames(
    rep(c(22, 23, 24, 25), length.out = length(non_na_levels)),
    non_na_levels
  )

  if ("NA" %in% shape_levels) shape_values["NA"] <- 21

  shape_values
})
sdPlot_gg <- reactive({
  req(donorCount() >= 2)
  df <- final_plot_data()

  # cutoffs from EM function 
  co <- tryCatch(cutoff_estimation(), error = function(e) NULL)
  cutoff_low  <- if (!is.null(co) && !is.null(co$cutoffs)) co$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low  else NA_real_
  cutoff_high <- if (!is.null(co) && !is.null(co$cutoffs)) co$cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High else NA_real_

  # tolerance band width for highlighting near the thresholds
  eps <- 0   

  # SD across donors 
  variant_sd <- apply(
    cbind(df$ScaledFoldChange_d1, df$ScaledFoldChange_d2, df$ScaledFoldChange_d3),
    1,
    function(v) { v <- as.numeric(v); if (sum(!is.na(v)) < 2) NA_real_ else stats::sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) }
  )

  # ensure ClinVar column exists 
  if (!"Database_Classifications" %in% names(df)) df$Database_Classifications <- NA
  

  #  scalar helpers OUTSIDE mutate() 
  both_avail <- !is.na(cutoff_low) && !is.na(cutoff_high)
int_min    <- if (both_avail) min(cutoff_low, cutoff_high) else NA_real_
int_max    <- if (both_avail) max(cutoff_low, cutoff_high) else NA_real_
  # prep data, compute flag ONLY if the SD bar spans the FULL interval between BOTH cutoffs
  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Variant_SD = variant_sd,
      score_mean = ScaledFoldChange_mean,
      Functionality = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(score_mean) & !is.na(cutoff_low)  & score_mean <= cutoff_low  ~ "Non-functional",
        !is.na(score_mean) & !is.na(cutoff_high) & score_mean >= cutoff_high ~ "Functional",
        TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Variant_SD), !is.na(score_mean)) %>%
  mutate(
    bar_min    = score_mean - Variant_SD,
    bar_max    = score_mean + Variant_SD,
    spans_both = both_avail &
                 (bar_min <= (int_min + eps)) &
                 (bar_max >= (int_max - eps)),
    Overlap    = ifelse(spans_both, "Spans both thresholds", "Does not span both thresholds"),
    .hover = paste0(
      "cDNA Pos: ", cDNA..,
      "<br>Mutation Code: ", Mutation_code,
      "<br>New Variant Score: ", round(score_mean, 3),
      "<br>SD: ", round(Variant_SD, 3),
      "<br>Donor1: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d1, 3),
      "<br>Donor2: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d2, 3),
      "<br>Donor3: ", round(ScaledFoldChange_d3, 3),
      "<br>Mutation Type: ", Mutation.type,
      "<br>Database: ", Database_Classifications,
      "<br>Screen Classification: ", Functionality
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Overlap) # non-overlappers first; overlappers on top
  
  plot_df <- prepare_clinvar_shapes_fill(plot_df)
  # plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = score_mean, y = Variant_SD)) +
    { if (!is.na(cutoff_low))
        annotate("rect", xmin = cutoff_low - eps, xmax = cutoff_low + eps,
                 ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.08, fill = "brown") } +
    { if (!is.na(cutoff_high))
        annotate("rect", xmin = cutoff_high - eps, xmax = cutoff_high + eps,
                 ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.08, fill = "blue") } +
    geom_segment(aes(x = score_mean - Variant_SD,
                     xend = score_mean + Variant_SD,
                     y = Variant_SD, yend = Variant_SD,
                     color = Overlap, alpha = Overlap, linewidth = Overlap)) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(plot_df, Overlap == "Does not span both thresholds"),
      aes(fill = Mutation.type, shape = Database_Classifications, text = .hover),
      size = 2.2, stroke = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(plot_df, Overlap == "Spans both thresholds"),
      aes(fill = Mutation.type, shape = Database_Classifications, text = .hover),
      size = 2.8, color = "black", stroke = 0.6
    ) +
    { if (!is.na(cutoff_low))  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff_low,  linetype = "dashed", color = "brown") } +
    { if (!is.na(cutoff_high)) geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff_high, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") } +
    scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d"),
  name = "Mutation Type") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = clinvar_fill_shape_values(), drop = FALSE, name = "Database Classification") +
guides(
  fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      shape = 21,
      size = 4,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 1
    )
  ),
  shape = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      size = 4,
      alpha = 1
    )
  )
) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Spans both thresholds" = "black",
                                  "Does not span both thresholds" = "gray55"),
                       name = "Overlap") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Spans both thresholds" = 1.0,
                                  "Does not span both thresholds" = 0.30),
                       guide = "none") +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("Spans both thresholds" = 0.9,
                                      "Does not span both thresholds" = 0.4),
                           guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Standard Deviation vs Score",
         x = " Average Screen Score", y = "Standard Deviation") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
          axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

  p
})

 # ---- 11a. Plot: Donor1 LOESS Fit ----
parse_cas9_cutsites <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(numeric(0))

  vals <- unlist(strsplit(x, split = "[,;\\s]+"))
  vals <- trimws(vals)
  vals <- vals[vals != ""]

  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]

  vals
}
donor1Plot_gg <- reactive({
  df_all <- averaged_data()
  syn_min <- attr(df_all, "syn_min1")

  exclude_vec <- strsplit(input$excluded_codes, ",")[[1]] %>% trimws()
  exclude_vec <- exclude_vec[exclude_vec != ""]

  cas9_cutsites <- parse_cas9_cutsites(input$cas9_cutsites)
  
# Extract only donor 1 data
  df <- df_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(cDNA_Position_d1), !is.na(Variant_Score_d1), !is.na(Mutation_Type_d1))
  
#remove excluded variants from plot, since they are not used for normalization
  if (length(exclude_vec) > 0) {
    df <- df %>% filter(!(Mutation_code %in% exclude_vec))
  }
  
# Filter for LOESS fit ( LOESS fit line for Syn-filtered data)
  df_loess <- df %>% filter(Variant_Score_d1 >= syn_min)

  cDNA_grid <- seq(min(df_loess$cDNA_Position_d1), max(df_loess$cDNA_Position_d1), length.out = 500)

  loess_fit <- loess(Variant_Score_d1 ~ cDNA_Position_d1, data = df_loess, span = input$loess_span)
  
# Fit LOESS using filtered points
  loess_line <- data.frame(
    cDNA_Position_d1 = cDNA_grid,
    loess_y = predict(loess_fit, newdata = data.frame(cDNA_Position_d1 = cDNA_grid))
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cDNA_Position_d1, y = Variant_Score_d1,
                      text = paste0("cDNA Pos: ", cDNA_Position_d1, "<br>",
                                    "Raw Score: ", round(Variant_Score_d1, 3), "<br>",
                                    "Mutation Type: ", Mutation_Type_d1, "<br>",
                                    "Mutation Code: ", Mutation_code))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Mutation_Type_d1), size = 1.2) +
    geom_line(data = loess_line, aes(x = cDNA_Position_d1, y = loess_y),
              color = "red", size = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cas9_cutsites, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Mis" = "#1f77b4", "Non" = "#e63f29", "Syn" = "#42bd0d"),
                       name = "Mutation Type") +
    labs(title = paste0("Donor 1 LOESS Fit (Syn Min = ", round(syn_min, 3), ")"),
         x = "cDNA Position", y = "Unadjusted Donor 1 Score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right")

  p
})

output$donor1Plot <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(donor1Plot_gg(), tooltip = "text")
})

output$cutoffTable <- renderTable({
  cutoff_obj <- cutoff_estimation()        
  cutoffs <- cutoff_obj$cutoffs           
  model <- cutoff_obj$model                
  df <- final_plot_data()

  # Classification based on cutoffs
  df <- df %>%
  mutate(Classification = case_when(
    adj_avg_score <= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low ~ "Non-functional",
    adj_avg_score >= cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High ~ "Functional",
    TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
  ))

# Overall proportions
prop_overall <- df %>%
  count(Classification, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Value = round(Count / sum(Count), 3),
         Type = "Overall") %>%
  select(Type, Classification, Count, Value)

# By Mutation type
prop_by_type <- df %>%
  group_by(Mutation.type, Classification) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Mutation.type) %>%
  mutate(Value = round(Count / sum(Count), 3),
         Type = as.character(Mutation.type)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Type, Classification, Count, Value)

# By ClinVar classification
prop_by_clinvar <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Database_Classifications)) %>%
  group_by(Database_Classifications, Classification) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Database_Classifications) %>%
  mutate(Value = round(Count / sum(Count), 3),
         Type = paste0("Database: ", Database_Classifications)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Type, Classification, Count, Value)

#  Donor correlations (pairwise + overall), only when available
mk_pair_row <- function(df, xnm, ynm, lab) {
  if (!all(c(xnm, ynm) %in% names(df))) return(NULL)
  x <- df[[xnm]]; y <- df[[ynm]]
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NULL)  # avoid "no complete element pairs"
  r <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x[ok], y[ok]))
  data.frame(
    Type = paste0("Donor Correlation: ", lab),
    Classification = NA, Count = NA,
    Value = round(r, 3)
  )
}

#multivariate donor correlation; how well data is predicted by best fit vector for 3 variable-axis
bestfit3D_R2 <- function(df, cols) {
  if (!all(cols %in% names(df))) return(NULL)
  X <- df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
  X <- stats::na.omit(X)
  if (nrow(X) < 2) return(NULL)  # need at least 2 points for any variance
  p <- stats::prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  if (length(p$sdev) < 1 || sum(p$sdev^2) == 0) return(NULL)
  R2 <- (p$sdev[1]^2) / sum(p$sdev^2)
  data.frame(
    Type = "3 Donor R²",
    Classification = NA, Count = NA,
    Value = round(R2, 3)
  )
}

pair_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  mk_pair_row(df, "ScaledFoldChange_d1", "ScaledFoldChange_d2", "D1 vs D2"),
  mk_pair_row(df, "ScaledFoldChange_d1", "ScaledFoldChange_d3", "D1 vs D3"),
  mk_pair_row(df, "ScaledFoldChange_d2", "ScaledFoldChange_d3", "D2 vs D3")
)

r2_row <- bestfit3D_R2(df, c("ScaledFoldChange_d1","ScaledFoldChange_d2","ScaledFoldChange_d3"))

donor_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(pair_rows, r2_row)

# EM Iteration count row
iter_val <- tryCatch({
  if (!is.null(model) && !is.null(model$all.loglik)) {
    length(model$all.loglik)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}, error = function(e) NA_real_)

iter_row <- data.frame(
  Type = "EM Model Iterations",
  Classification = NA,
  Count = NA,
  Value = iter_val - 1
)

# Combine all rows
summary_stats <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    Type = "Classification Threshold",
    Classification = c("Lower Bound", "Upper Bound"),
    Count = NA,
    Value = round(c(cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_Low, cutoffs$Est_Cutoff_High), 3)
  ),
  iter_row,
  prop_overall,
  prop_by_type,
  prop_by_clinvar,
  donor_rows
)

summary_stats$Value <- round(as.numeric(summary_stats$Value), 3)
summary_stats
}, digits = 3)
